verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Next.js serves an llms.txt at nextjs.org/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and Markdown docs at /docs.md with a docs_index. A docs-scoped /docs/llms.txt also indexes guide pages, including one on giving coding agents access through a built-in MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on how to point agents at llms.txt, and independent reports of agents consuming these files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://nextjs.org/llms.txt # Next.js
